title: “These Are More Than Words”: An Interdisciplinary Concept Map for Hip-Hop Scholars
description: An interactive map of over 8,000 works of hip-hop scholarship in 95 clusters, grouped into twelve overlapping conceptual groupings, in three views (Bling, Blob, and Brain). Every work comes from the dataset The Scholars Got Something To Say, version 2.0. Designed by Rachel Bomalaski. Built with AI assistance (Claude, Anthropic).
